**Conclusion: compliant (sits at/above the IP fallback) — no redline proposed.**

Clear Capital owns the Works outright subject to payment, backed by an express present assignment of works in progress; RadialSpark keeps only its generic pre-existing tools and know-how; we hold a perpetual, royalty-free, sublicensable modify-and-use licence to any Contractor IP embedded in the Works; none of our IP or data is assigned or licensed to RadialSpark; and there is no joint ownership. The only shortfalls against the preferred position are cosmetic (no "irrevocable"/"worldwide" labels on the §4(c) licence and no standalone Customer Data ownership sentence), which I noted in the rationale rather than flagging. If §4 is opened for other reasons, we could add "irrevocable, worldwide" to §4(c) and a one-line data-ownership confirmation as low-cost housekeeping.
